title: SMPL machines
author: Iced-Cream
description: SMPL machines: a second machine layer on the SMPL page. Mods add machines through smpl_machines and get their ids by count (an id pool the lockfile keeps); a sound runs the one its SRC machine requires, or the one picked on the SAMPLE key's SMPL MACHINE page (AUTO: its SRC machine's default, or stock). For a sound that runs one, the SMPL page shows the machine's title, labels, names, looks, ranges and values on stock's records 39..46, so the values still store, p-lock, slide and take the LFO and MIDI; stock's sample layer stays silent on its voice and the machine's engine gets the words each block. On its own, or for a sound that runs none, it changes nothing but the extra page.
